description: This file defines the ReactAgentScreen widget, which serves as the main user interface for a Flutter app implementing a ReAct agent. It includes UI elements such as header, input area, steps list, and debug panel, managing interaction with ReactAgentController.

classes.name: ReactAgentScreen
classes.description: Main stateful widget representing the ReAct agent's primary interface, including header, input area, steps display, and debug overlay.

classes.name: _ReactAgentScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the logic and state of ReactAgentScreen, including controllers, UI updates, and interactions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes controllers, sets up listener for state changes.

methods.name: _onChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when controller's state changes, manages auto-scrolling and UI rebuilds.

methods.name: _toggleDebugPanel
methods.description: Toggles visibility of debug overlay panel.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up controllers and listeners when widget is disposed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main UI of the screen, including header, steps, and debug overlay.

methods.name: _buildHeader
methods.description: Constructs the header section with title, description, input field, and action buttons.

methods.name: _buildSteps
methods.description: Builds the list view displaying steps taken by the agent.

methods.name: _buildEmpty
methods.description: Displays placeholder when no steps are present.
